preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root must be an instance of TreeNode or None.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, int) for node in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the return value must be integers.
The length of the return value must equal the number of nodes in the tree.
The return value must be the preorder traversal of the tree.
